answer: Farming becomes a gale bet on surviving 68 epochs of grading, and every pearl settlement recomputes the falcon schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 68 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
